data.name: Silica
data.description: Silica is an ERW project developer permanently removing CO2 in LatAm, starting with Mexican sugarcane regions, with a mission to remove CO2 at scale while regenerating soils, increasing crop yields and improving the livelihoods of rural communities. The company is a member of the Enhanced Weathering Alliance and generates carbon removal credits through spreading silicate rock dust on agricultural lands.
